concerns.text: Task T028 (Power limitation check) is listed BEFORE T021b (Simulation) but depends on T015 (Data Generation) which is in Phase 3. The task description says 'Must run BEFORE simulation tasks T021b', but T028 is placed in Phase 4 (US2) while T015 is in Phase 3 (US1). This creates a cross-phase dependency violation where a blocking prerequisite (T028) is defined in a later phase than its data source (T015). The task should be moved to Phase 3 or explicitly marked as a dependency of T021b with a note that it requires T015 completion.

Task T024a (Select representative topologies) depends on T015 (data/raw/networks.csv) but is listed in Phase 4 (US2) while T015 is in Phase 3 (US1). The dependency chain is correct (T024a -> T015), but the phase organization suggests T024a can only start after Phase 3 is complete, which is correct. However, T024a is marked as [US2] but its primary dependency is on US1 data. This is acceptable but should be noted that US2 cannot start until US1 data is generated.

Task T031a (Load data for regression) depends on T026 (Export results to energy_decay.csv) which is in Phase 4 (US2). T031a is correctly placed in Phase 5 (US3) and depends on T026. However, T031a also depends on T015 (networks.csv) which is in Phase 3. The task description correctly notes 'Depends on T026; NOT parallel-safe' but should also explicitly note the dependency on T015 to ensure the full data flow is clear.

Task T022a, T022b, T022c are marked as [P] (parallel-safe) but T022b depends on T021b and T022c depends on T022b. The [P] tag on T022a is correct (no data dependency), but T022b and T022c should NOT be marked as [P] since they have explicit dependencies on previous tasks. This creates a false impression of parallelism.

Task T023a is marked as [P] (parallel-safe) but T024b depends on T023a. While T023a itself may be parallel-safe, the dependency chain T023a -> T024b means T024b cannot run in parallel with T023a. The [P] tag on T023a is acceptable, but the phase organization should clarify that T024b must wait for T023a completion.
